$comment: Machine-readable update manifest. Bump latestVersion, versionCode and the download URLs with every release. The desktop app prefers electron-updater (latest.yml on GitHub Releases); this file is the stable, cacheable endpoint for anything that cannot use it, and for future mobile builds.
releaseNotes: Python debugging works — debugpy is installed automatically
Toolchain panel reaches the backend (absolute URL)
Python and C/C++ files open with the right language, not Plain Text
Update status visible in the status bar
Run C/C++ without a shell — no more exit-code 127
